# Worm, phase 4 (run with --no-save after p3_splat_fit.txt): the game's parts. head.glb: the head on a
# stippled pool of light 0.56 m in radius; bead.glb: the first (largest) bead on a pool 0.40 m in
# radius. Each part's origin on the floor under its centre (the game's pivot), moved to the world
# origin. The pool: ../env/halo.png, alpha-masked (make_env.py). Generated by make_worm.py.
material new Halo --base-color 1 1 1 --emission 0.2667 0.3020 0.5176 --no-slot
material texture Halo base-color ../env/halo.png
material set Halo alpha-mode mask
material set Halo alpha-cutoff 0.5
select Head
cursor set 0 0 0
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
add mesh circle --name HeadPool --vertices 16 --radius 0.56 --cap-fill ngon --location 0 0 0.03
material assign Halo
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
select HeadPool Head
active Head
join
select Head
shade flat
export head.glb --selection
select Bead0
cursor set 0 0.3487 0
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
add mesh circle --name BeadPool --vertices 16 --radius 0.40 --cap-fill ngon --location 0 0 0.03
material assign Halo
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
select BeadPool Bead0
active Bead0
join
select Bead0
shade flat
export bead.glb --selection
